name: htop
description: An enhanced, interactive process viewer with colors, mouse support, tree view, and easy filtering — friendlier than top.

flags.description: Refresh delay in tenths of a second.
Built-in function keys: F3 search, F4 filter, F5 tree, F6 sort, F9 kill, F10 quit.

examples.explanation: Opens the interactive monitor: colored CPU/ RAM/swap bars, a scrollable process list, and mouse support.
Filters the view to web server processes.
Inside htop: toggles tree view, showing parent-child process relationships visually.

about: htop shows the same data as top but with per-core bars, easy sorting, text search (F3), filtering (F4), and tag-then-kill workflows. It is a separate package (install with your package manager) and does not exist on minimal systems where top always does.
useCases: Teaching process management — the UI is self-explanatory.
mistakes: Assuming htop is preinstalled on servers — often it is not; install it explicitly.
